nodes.name: O2 Regulator Fault Response
nodes.text: If O2 regulator is stuck, manually adjust supplemental O2 flow. Monitor ppO2 continuously. Target 21.3 kPa. Alert if ppO2 drops below 19.5 kPa.

nodes.name: Cabin Leak Isolation
nodes.text: Isolate affected section. Don emergency O2 masks. Locate leak using pressure differential sensors. Apply emergency patch. Verify cabin pressure recovery.

nodes.name: CO2 Scrubber Maintenance
nodes.text: Replace CO2 scrubber cartridge. Verify ppCO2 begins decreasing within 10 minutes. Nominal ppCO2 target: < 0.5 kPa.

nodes.name: Hypoxia Response Protocol
nodes.text: SYNTHETIC: NOT REAL MEDICAL PROCEDURE. Restore O2 supply. Move affected crew to safe volume. Apply supplemental O2. Monitor SpO2 continuously. Target SpO2 > 95%.

nodes.name: Rapid Decompression Response
nodes.text: SYNTHETIC: NOT REAL MEDICAL PROCEDURE. Don emergency suits immediately. Seal affected compartment. Initiate emergency repressurization. Check all crew for decompression symptoms.

nodes.text: Telemetry sensor: Crew SpO2 Wearable Sensor

nodes.name: Crew Hypoxia
nodes.text: Insufficient oxygen partial pressure in cabin

nodes.name: CO2 Toxicity
nodes.text: Elevated carbon dioxide partial pressure causing crew impairment

nodes.name: Rapid Decompression
nodes.text: Loss of cabin pressure due to structural breach
